answer: One concrete mechanism: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because pearl only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, delta is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any zephyr approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
